name: Starhill Global Real Estate Investment Trust
summary: Starhill Global Real Estate Investment Trust (SGLMF) is a Singapore-headquartered REIT that primarily invests in commercial real estate, specifically retail and office properties, across Singapore, Australia, Malaysia, China, and Japan. Launched on the Singapore Exchange (SGX-ST) Mainboard on September 20, 2005, its operations are overseen by an external manager, YTL Starhill Global REIT Management Limited.
